profile: Systems Engineer with experience in data engineering, backend and AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP, AI Agents, SDD). Built 4 production MCP servers to operate Dagster, SQL Server and Microsoft Graph from Claude Code. I build ETL pipelines with Dagster and Python for a SQL Server DWH, with Discord/Telegram alerting. Previously developed REST APIs with FastAPI and NestJS, and integrated VITEK lab equipment via ASTM/HL7.

responsibilities: Built competitor price scrapers for 4 retailers with daily extraction in Dagster and reverse engineering of obfuscated APIs.
Developed bank reconciliation pipelines (Credomatic/BAC, Ficohsa) and transactional pipelines (Netflix, Tengo, Rapibac) over SMB and SQL Server.
Integrated Discord webhook alerts as a second failure-notification channel, with strict TDD (13 tests) and graceful degradation independent from email.
Built an autonomous watchdog system that detects stuck pipelines, automatically re-launches them and notifies via Telegram, complemented with native timeouts (dagster/max_runtime) on 27+ jobs.
Automated cash-closing flows, migrated legacy Windows processes to Dagster and standardized DWH tables with metadata (country, source, versions) for Power BI consumption.
Developed 4 production MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers enabling Tool Use / Function Calling over Dagster, SQL Server, Microsoft Graph/Outlook and API health checks from Claude Code.

Applied Agentic AI with sub-agent orchestration, Anthropic Agent Skills (SKILL.md), slash commands and hooks across Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode, under SDD methodology and strict TDD, applying Prompt Engineering to accelerate delivery.
